TextView.android:text: Here you can learn about malware, phishing, safe browsing, and more...

• **Home (Dashboard):** Displays your device’s current security status, recent threats, and quick scan options. Includes charts and summaries for a clear overview. 

• **Scan Tab:** Lets you perform quick or full scans. You can also view your scan history and results. 

• **Threats Tab:** Lists all detected malware and suspicious files. Each item includes details, threat level, and actions such as Delete, Quarantine, or Ignore. 

• **Settings Tab:** Manage notifications, safe browsing, and other preferences. You can access settings from any screen using the gear icon in the top-right corner.

• **Malware:** Any malicious software designed to harm your device or steal data. 

• **Trojan:** A type of malware disguised as a legitimate file or app to trick users into installing it. 

• **Phishing:** A fraudulent attempt to obtain sensitive information (like passwords) by pretending to be a trusted source. 

• **Ransomware:** Malware that locks your files or system and demands payment to restore access. 

• **Adware:** Software that displays unwanted ads and may track user behavior. 

• **Quarantine:** A secure location where detected threats are isolated so they can’t cause harm. 

• **Signature:** A unique pattern used to identify known malware. 

• **Heuristic Analysis:** A method used to detect unknown or modified malware based on suspicious behavior rather than known signatures.
